Now the duplicate is removed. Let me implement the actual fix. The issue is that the loop treats a FK-as-PK (OneToOneField with primary_key=True) as concrete inheritance. The fix is to track whether the field is a parent link and only apply the "found from local model" shortcut for actual parent links.

Let me look at the upstream fix approach. The correct fix checks `field.remote_field.parent_link`:

                # Lookups on nonexistent fields are ok, since they're ignored

                break

                # This is not a relational field, so further parts
